title: Metaplanet Buys the Dip — Securing a Massive Bitcoin Position as Price Stays Below $112,000
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Metaplanet Buys the Dip — Securing a Massive Bitcoin Position as Price Stays Below $112,000 With Bitcoin price hovering below $112,000, Japanese investment giant Metaplanet Inc. has acquired an additional 136 BTC for $15.2 million, bringing its total holdings to 20,136 BTC acquired for $2.08 billion.
